test_title: SSC CHSL Exam 2023 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jan, 2024 Shift 1).
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options.

While astrology has / a long history / it is generally / considered pseudoscience.
solution:
The correct answer is option 4 i.e. considered pseudoscience.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• A definite article "**a**" is required before "**pseudoscience**" to be grammatically correct.
 
• The correct phrase should be **"considered a pseudoscience."**
 
• The other parts of the sentence are grammatically correct.

Hence, the part with the error is option 4.
